definition.description: Fetches subscriptions for a customer from Microsoft Partner Center API. Optionally fetch a single subscription by ID.

inputFields.helpText: Leave empty to fetch all subscriptions, or provide a specific subscription GUID

inputFields.placeholderText: Bearer token from Partner Center authentication
inputFields.helpText: OAuth access token for Partner Center API (without 'Bearer' prefix)

outputParameters.description: Raw JSON response from the API
Error message if the request fails

connectionTags.description: Triggered when subscriptions are fetched successfully
Triggered when the API call fails
